 Persebaya Surabaya Bounces Back with 4-3 Win, Bernardo Tavares Prepares Team for Java United
 Persebaya Surabaya is ready to face Java United FC at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium after securing a 4-3 friendly win over the Western Australia Football Team.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Niken Pramudya 
 November 17, 2026 at 2:44 AM WITA ·
 5 min read
 Photo caption: Archive of Persebaya Surabaya players celebrating during a match at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium. (Photo: Persebaya) 
 SURABAYA, Aktualita.co -   Persebaya Surabaya has received a confidence boost ahead of the resumption of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. The team, nicknamed Bajul Ijo, successfully defeated the Western Australia Football Team with a score of 4-3 in an international friendly match at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium on Sunday (15/11/2026). 
 The victory serves as a breath of fresh air for Bernardo Tavares' squad after going three matches without a win across various competitions. This positive result also provides the Portuguese coach with an opportunity to evaluate his squad's depth before facing Java United FC on Saturday, November 21, 2026.

 Although it was only a friendly match, Persebaya's success in turning the game around after trailing demonstrates the team's fighting spirit. Several players who previously had limited playing time also made significant contributions. 
 Persebaya is now looking to carry this momentum into official matches. Moreover, the competition in the middle of the Super League table is becoming increasingly tight, and every point has the potential to affect the team's position. 
 Four Persebaya Goals Provide Foundation for Revival 
 The match against Western Australia saw seven goals scored throughout the game. Persebaya, who had been trailing, were able to show a positive response in the second half. 
 Risto Mitrevski opened the scoring for Persebaya in the 63rd minute. Just one minute later, Alfan Suaib added his name to the scoresheet. 
 Alex Martins then contributed a goal in the 72nd minute, before Gledson Paixao secured the victory with a goal in the 89th minute. 
 Four goals from four different players represent an interesting development for Persebaya. The team is not solely dependent on one player to score, but is receiving contributions from various positions. 
 However, the victory does not entirely resolve the coaching staff's homework. The three goals conceded by Persebaya remain a point of evaluation, particularly regarding defensive organization when facing opponent pressure. 
 The difference in character between friendly matches and official competitions also means this result cannot yet be used as a definitive measure of Persebaya's readiness for upcoming matches. 
 Bernardo Tavares Satisfied with Players Who Received Opportunities 
 Persebaya coach Bernardo Tavares used the match to give opportunities to several players who have had minimal playing time. 
 Alfan Suaib, Yusuf Meilana, Paulinus Kapli, and Lutfi Masrohan were among the players who had the chance to showcase their abilities. New recruit Matheus Lagoa also experienced the match atmosphere again after recovering from an injury. 
 Tavares believes that providing playing opportunities is important for creating healthy competition within the team. 
 "This is how we create competition within the squad, by giving playing minutes to our players," said Bernardo Tavares in the post-match press conference. 
 According to Tavares, players returning from injury need opportunities to regain their match rhythm. On the other hand, young players must be able to show their readiness if they want to earn more playing time. 
 The Portuguese coach also noted several opportunities that could have been better capitalized into goals. 
 This situation shows that the victory has not solved all of Persebaya's problems. Consistency in play remains a concern as the team returns to matches with higher competitive intensity. 
 Ernando Ari Says Victory Boosts Confidence 
 Persebaya goalkeeper Ernando Ari Sutaryadi also welcomed the result of the match against Western Australia. 
 The victory feels important after Persebaya went through a series of unsatisfactory matches. 
 On October 30, 2026, Persebaya was held to a 1-1 draw by Persijap Jepara. The next result was no better, losing 2-3 to Kendal Tornado FC in the I.League Cup on November 3. 
 Persebaya then dropped points again after a 0-1 defeat to Persija Jakarta at the Jakarta International Stadium on November 7, 2026. 
 Ernando believes that having more players ready to be fielded will help the team face the upcoming match schedule. 
 "It is very helpful for our team, and there are more players the coach can choose for the next match," said Ernando Ari. 
 The Semarang-born goalkeeper also views the match against Java United as an important agenda that must immediately become the team's focus. 
 With more players available, Tavares has the opportunity to adjust the player composition based on tactical needs and the physical condition of each individual. 
 Persebaya's Position in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League Standings 
 Based on the official standings after nine matches, Persebaya Surabaya sits in eighth place with 13 points. 
 Bajul Ijo has recorded three wins, four draws, and two losses. From those nine matches, Persebaya has scored 10 goals and conceded eight. 
 Persebaya's point total is the same as Java United, who are one spot above them in seventh place. The two teams are separated only by goal difference. 
 Meanwhile, Persija Jakarta still leads the standings with 21 points, followed by Dewa United with 20 points. 
 This situation makes the match between Persebaya and Java United significant. A win could help Bajul Ijo improve their position while maintaining competition with the teams at the top. 
 Conversely, dropping points at home could make it increasingly difficult for Persebaya to catch the top group. 
 Persebaya Surabaya's Next Schedule 
 Persebaya is scheduled to host Java United FC in the tenth week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League. 
 The match will take place at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium, Surabaya, on Saturday, November 21, 2026, with kickoff at 15:30 WIB or 16:30 WITA. 
 The match is an opportunity for Persebaya to prove that the victory over Western Australia was not just a positive result in a friendly match. 
 After facing Java United, Persebaya has an I.League Cup match against PSBS Biak on November 24, 2026. 
 Next, Bajul Ijo is scheduled to face Arema FC on November 29, before hosting Persib Bandung on December 6, 2026, in the continuation of the Super League. 
 This series of matches requires Persebaya to maintain player fitness while sustaining consistency in their play. 
 The support of the Bonek and Bonita at Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium is expected to be an additional source of energy when Persebaya returns to play home matches. 
 Now, Bernardo Tavares' biggest challenge is not just maintaining morale after the 4-3 win, but translating the positive progress from the friendly match into tangible results in the competition. 
 Persebaya needs a win over Java United to improve their league position and rebuild momentum in this season's BRI Super League competition.
